name: Maple
description: A unified MCP server providing observability, safety control, and behavior evolution for high-agency AI agents through tracing, replaying, and auditing. It features real-time firewall guardrails and ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor, block, or fork agent actions based on risk.

rawRecord.description: A unified MCP server providing observability, safety control, and behavior evolution for high-agency AI agents through tracing, replaying, and auditing. It features real-time firewall guardrails and ML-driven anomaly detection to monitor, block, or fork agent actions based on risk.

MCP_URL.description: The URL where the MCP server is hosted (e.g., http://localhost:3000).

MAPLE_API_KEY.description: API key for authenticating with the Maple server. Auth is fail-closed by default.

MAPLE_API_KEYS.description: Alternative to MAPLE_API_KEY, allows providing multiple keys.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI to enable AI-powered firewall chat mode.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token for the slack_post_message tool (alternative to webhook mode).

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: API key for Anthropic to enable AI-powered firewall chat mode.

DEMO_OPEN_BROWSER.description: Set to '0' to disable auto-opening browser pages during demo:up.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Incoming webhook URL for the slack_post_message tool.

MAPLE_ALLOW_NO_AUTH.description: If set to 'true', allows local-only bypass of API key authentication (not recommended).

OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_URL.description: The URL of the OpenClaw bridge adapter. Required in production.

OPENCLAW_BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: The token used to authenticate with the OpenClaw bridge. Required in production.

SLACK_DEFAULT_CHANNEL.description: Optional default channel for Slack bot mode.

MAPLE_FIREWALL_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable deterministic firewall policy checks (true | false).

MAPLE_LOCK_BRIDGE_TARGET.description: Set to 'true' to deny per-request bridgeUrl/token overrides. Enabled automatically in production.

MAPLE_ALLOW_BRIDGE_OVERRIDE.description: If set to 'true', allows local-only override of the bridge configuration.

MAPLE_FIREWALL_CHAT_PRIMARY.description: Primary model provider for firewall chat (openai | anthropic).

MAPLE_FIREWALL_CHAT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for firewall chat AI responses.

MAPLE_FIREWALL_CHAT_OPENAI_MODEL.description: Specific OpenAI model for firewall chat (e.g., gpt-4o-mini).

MAPLE_FIREWALL_CHAT_ANTHROPIC_MODEL.description: Specific Anthropic model for firewall chat (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6).
